headline: Frontlines Intensify as Casualties Mount Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the fighting has sharpened on the most contested fronts. Callums Cape now records roughly 1,656 Colonial and 1,200 Warden casualties per hour with 82 new enlistees, a marked acceleration from the prior surge. Linn Mercy adds about 324 Colonial and 729 Warden losses per hour alongside 85 recruits, both trends flagged accelerating. Mooring County remains the bloodiest theatre, posting some 1,738 Colonial and 1,458 Warden dead per hour and 104 enlistments, all rising sharply. Nevish Line shows a modest but growing toll of 27 Colonial and 16 Warden casualties per hour with 26 enlistments, each rate accelerating. Weathered Expanse reports 843 Colonial and 715 Warden casualties per hour and 44 enlistments, a fourfold increase over the earlier period. Marban Hollow contributes 12 Colonial and 20 Warden losses per hour with 30 recruits, also accelerating. Event logs confirm heightened base turnover on these six sectors, together accounting for the bulk of ownership changes in the past day, while quieter regions show little or no activity.
